zara: Quick thread for the relnotes + docs sweep: targets are migration guide v0.9->v1.0, unified streaming snippets, and a Known Issues blurb about embed streaming fallback. Need copy + CI fixes by Thursday.
jay: I'll audit SDK snippets. Noted mismatched python/js streaming calls. Point me to the PR.
zara: PR #4380 (streaming-snippets). I flagged an outdated client.call() in python.
miguel: I'll update curl examples to use /v1/streams and add a jq parsing example for chunked tokens.
elaine: I ran anchor-check; results: migration.md missing #private-deploy anchor; streaming.md example id mismatch.
docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck failed on #4380 (2 anchors).
sam: I'll add frontmatter redirects for the renamed anchors to preserve links, pushing a tiny patch.
jay: Proposal: standardize on client.generate_stream() in docs, add compatibility note for older SDKs exposing client.stream.*. Pushed draft to PR #4382.
miguel: If snippet-tests fail for older runners, we'll call that out in relnotes: "Snippets assume SDK >=0.9.1; see compatibility notes."
zara: I'll draft the relnotes bullet points and a short Known Issues line: "If embed streaming falls back to polling, tokens may be delayed up to ~2s; automatic retry will resume streaming when capacity is available." Please ping this thread when fixes are pushed. :tada:
